unit.why: A short anecdote: R. Naftali of Ropshitz, visiting R. Zvi of Zhidachov with his son Eliezer, asks the boy who will succeed this tsaddik, and praises his answer.

stories.start_quote: סיפר מחו' הרה״ק מו"ה אליעזר מדזיקאב
stories.summary_en: R. Eliezer of Dzikov told the sons of the book's master that, when he was at Zhidachov with his father R. Naftali of Ropshitz visiting R. Zvi, his father asked him who would fill that tsaddik's place, and when the boy pointed to 'our master' his father praised his wisdom.

quotes: שבהיותו עם אביו הרה״ק ר׳ נפתלי מרופשיטץ
tags.why: Father and son, both tsaddikim, are the actors

quotes: מי ימלא מקום הצדיק הזה לאחר מאה שנים
tags.why: The question is who will succeed R. Zvi
The Ropshitzer and his son stay with another tsaddik at Zhidachov

quotes: סיפר מחו' הרה״ק מו"ה אליעזר מדזיקאב לבני מורינו
tags.why: The tale is framed as told by R. Eliezer to the master's sons
The son discerns the future leader; this may be spiritual insight

quotes: והראה לו על אביהם הוא מורינו
tags.why: Implied prediction of the master's future leadership
The anecdote serves to praise the book's master as R. Zvi's worthy successor
